core/tokens/starfield/params/catalog.ts

Catalog-facing parameters — well-known body ids and the
Source src/core/tokens/starfield/params/catalog.ts
UX surface Shared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

SUN

Heliocentric anchor — the deep-field cloud mounts on the Sun.

SF_COLORS

Procedural material palette — hex colors for bodies with no real imagery. Star tints follow spectral class (G yellow-white, B blue, M red); nebula/galaxy hues are emissive accents on a dark sprite.

HALLEY

Halley's nucleus — icy dust, faint cyan-white.

COMET_ION

Comet tail palette — the ion (plasma) tail glows blue-white from CO+ fluorescence under solar UV, while the dust tail scatters plain sunlight: a warm, dimmer, slightly yellowed streak. The nucleus itself is among the darkest bodies known (Halley albedo ≈ 0.04).

PLUME_ICE

Cryovolcanic/volcanic plume tints — Enceladus vents water-ice grains lit ice-blue; Io's plumes are sulfur/SO₂ fallout, a warm sulphurous gold.

TITAN_HAZE

Titan's tholin photochemical haze — the opaque orange limb glow overriding the Earth-blue atmosphere tint on its rim shell.

ISS

ISS truss — bright metallic white.

ISS_PANEL

ISS solar arrays — the wings' burnished gold kapton over silicon.

ATMO_DAY

Earth atmosphere fresnel tints — day limb, terminator dusk, night.

AURORA_JUPITER

Giant-planet aurora palettes — hydrogen-dominated upper atmospheres emit UV-blue curtains instead of Earth's oxygen green: Jupiter's powerful oval reads cyan-white, Saturn's a deep blue, Neptune's a faint violet (weak far-out field, 47°-tilted dipole).

TRAPPIST_B

Per-world tints for the seven-planet chain — shared color made every member read as the same ball. Inner pair scorched rock, mid worlds through the volatile line into the habitable-zone teal/ocean slate, outermost icy.

DWARF_SPH

Dwarf-galaxy tints — spheroidals get a warm old-population wash, irregulars a cooler young-star haze.

BH_JET

Sagittarius A* relativistic jets — blue synchrotron plasma.

SHELL_LOCAL

Cosmic-hierarchy shells + member speckles.

ASTEROID_BELT

Small-body belts — rocky rubble grey-brown, Kuiper ice blue-white.

ROCK_STONE

Belt hero-rock material classes — ordinary chondrite stone, carbonaceous black, nickel-iron sheen, cometary ice and regolith dust. Hero rocks pick one seeded class so the belt reads as mixed debris, not a single material.

STAR_BLUE

Star-cloud spectral ramp — B-V index stops for the real HYG field.

EXOPLANET_PT

Deep-field kind tints — exoplanet hosts warm, far-field DSOs cool.

BODY_NEUTRAL

Neutral body grey — fallback base tint for procedural surfaces when a catalog def carries no color (rare; satellites/loose bodies).

SUN_LIGHT

White sunlight point-light at the scene origin.

STAR_RIM

Photosphere limb tint — hot near-white that melts into the halo.

STAR_LIMB

Darkened limb — real photospheres show limb darkening (we see deeper, hotter layers at disc centre; the limb is higher, cooler gas). Stars that carry a rim def tint mix toward this deep amber at the silhouette instead of the default hot rim, so a resolved disc darkens at the edge the way the Sun does in H-alpha imagery.

STAR_FLARE

Hα eruption tint — prominence/ejecta plasma glows in hydrogen alpha, a saturated orange-red distinct from the photosphere's gold, so flares and arc prominences read as hot gas, not paint.

GLOW_INNER

Glow ramp stops — canvas gradient needs literal rgba strings.
